title: Smooth approximation of a compactly supported C¹ perturbation of the identity
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, K ⊆ U compact and φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P a C¹ map with φ(x) = x for x ∉ K. Then there are C^∞ maps ψ_k : ℝ^P → ℝ^P (k ∈ ℕ), a compact K' ⊆ U and a constant C such that ψ_k(x) = x for x ∉ K' and all k, ‖Dψ_k(x)‖ ≤ C for all k and x, and ψ_k(x) → φ(x), Dψ_k(x) → Dφ(x) as k → ∞ for every x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ x, x ∉ K → φ x = x) → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P) (K' : Set (Euclid P)) (C : ℝ), IsCompact K' ∧ K' ⊆ U ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (ψ k)) ∧ (∀ k x, x ∉ K' → ψ k x = x) ∧ (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (ψ k) x‖ ≤ C) ∧ (∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => ψ k x) atTop (𝓝 (φ x))) ∧ ∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => fderiv ℝ (ψ k) x) atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ φ x))
